description: List a store's subscriptions (recurring orders). Returns a HAL collection embedding fx:subscriptions. Foxy hAPI: GET /stores/{store_id}/subscriptions.

is_active.description: Filter to active (true) or inactive (false) subscriptions.

store_id.description: Store id. If omitted, the default store (fx:store) is used.

zoom.description: Comma-separated related resources to embed, e.g. 'transaction_template,last_transaction'.

name: foxy_list_subscriptions
title: List subscriptions
